meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm told you wanted this meeting. I have until 4:40. Why was my son's mark changed without a phone call?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," Hale. What do you have besides a score from a machine?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

I'm writing that down: "put it on his permanent record." Your own procedure says a first concern goes nowhere near his record, and it says you speak to the parent before any mark is entered, which nobody did. You can threaten me from here, Hale, or you can explain it to the principal, and I'm going there next.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing, because you never offered a document she could check.
What cost ground: "your son cheated" attacked Owen without evidence, and the threat about his permanent record hit the one thing she never trades.
Try next time: when she asked who decided on the zero and whether Owen was spoken to first, answer that question and own that the mark went in before you called her, instead of leading with the detector score.
